decisions.statement: A line says a label before a level and a level before a total.
Each column is written to the width of the widest entry in that column.
A label is written to the left of its column and a number to the right.
A total is floored to two decimal places rather than rounded.
A total is written to two decimal places whatever digits that total has.
A level is written as a whole number with no decimal place.
Nothing here reads a page or works a total out.

definition: a label, a level and a total written as one table with its columns aligned
